alevu: aleva paprika — ground red paprika; acc. case
crveni: Crveni krst — «Red Cross», Nazi camp in Niš
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
izvadim: izvaditi — to take out; 1st pers. sg.
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
kraju: kraj — end; na kraju — in the end, ultimately
luk: crni luk — yellow onion, beli luk — garlic
mesu: meso — meat; dat. case; mleveno meso — minced meat
mi: mi — we; short form «me» (potreban mi je — I need)
mlevenom: mleveno meso — minced meat; dat. case
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
nalijem: naliti — to pour, to fill; 1st pers. sg.
obe: oba, obe — both; sa obe strane — on both sides
otkriću: otkriti — to open, to reveal; future, 1st pers. sg.
papriku: aleva paprika — ground red paprika; acc. case
porumene: porumeneti — to turn golden brown; 3rd pers. pl.
sa: preposition + instr. case; + gen. case — «with, from» (sa mape — from the map)
ste: biti, 2nd pers. pl.: što ste tu — what are you doing here
strane: strana — side; s druge strane — on the other hand
sve: sav — all; neut. sg. or pl.
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
znali: znati; past, pl.; «Erste Znali» — website name
ćete: hteti; aux. verb future, 2nd pers. pl.
